messages:
sara: Quick follow-up to the All-Hands hybrid/office segment 7 answering a few policy bits we can confirm now. Drop anything else and we'll add it to the FAQ. :wave:

jon: If a manager wants a recurring "team day" (e.g., biweekly), is manager-only ok or need GM sign-off?

sara: Manager-only is fine. Publish on your team calendar. If it blocks shared rooms or affects other teams, loop in your GM so Facilities can coordinate.

maria: Any change to commuter/parking stipends?

sara: No immediate changes. The SF/CO pilot ends this quarter; we'll announce expansions with 30 days' notice. Case-by-case reviews for long-term parking.

lee: Offsite question: do we issue visa invitation letters and reimburse fees?

sara: Yes for company-sponsored offsites. Use the travel form and fill the "visa_support" field; pre-approved visa fees are reimbursable.

hannah: Childcare / partner travel? Any policy?

sara: We're running a small childcare/partner stipend pilot for select 2026 offsites. Details will be on the travel page; managers can ask for exceptions for critical contributors.

ops-bot: Reminder: submit travel requests at least 21 days for domestic travel, 30 days for international when visas are needed.

jon: Who signs off on date/budget exceptions?

sara: Operational exceptions = manager + People Ops. Budget exceptions escalate to Finance + GM.

maria: Hoteling: can we reserve a block of desks for a week-long workshop?

sara: Yes 12 submit a Facilities request 7 business days ahead for desk blocks and AV. For permanent reserved seats, request quarterly.

lee: Vendor list for flights/hotels? PO process?

sara: Preferred vendors are in the travel form dropdown. If a vendor is missing, choose "other" and tag procurement. For POs, contact finance@redwood and cc procurement. Use code EXP-OFFSITE-2026.

hannah: ADA/accommodation process? Confidential?

sara: Contact People Ops privately and we'll handle accommodations confidentially.

ops-bot: Tip: use project code EXP-OFFSITE-2026 on receipts for faster processing.

sara: Action items: I'll update the hybrid FAQ, publish a manager checklist for team in-office norms, and add childcare pilot details to the travel page by next Tue. I'll post links here when live and ping eng-leads. DM me for private follow-ups.
